text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Today I get to see Gimlet's total 
comeback~~! I'm suuuper hyped!!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
People are saying all sorts of things 
about her Trainer, but I really want her 
to do her best. Just seeing her run makes 
me happy, after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing before the place he had aimed 
for, Tanino Gimlet possessed an aura that 
felt almost poised—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, here lies the first trial to 
grace my new script.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What lies ahead is likely a realm beyond 
my destiny— It wouldn't be surprising if 
some kind of demon were to appear.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, I shall carve my own path forward! 
With my radiance rekindled through death 
and rebirth!!"
choice_data_list: Let's treat everyone to a cup.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed! Allow me to invite you to a 
long-awaited intoxication!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...! This wave of soul is...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kris S...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Ohh...! What incredible presence...! So 
they truly were destined to awaken this 
autumn!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(However—...What is this? Within the cold, 
stern waves of her soul, something else— 
another kind of weight...—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...To meet you once again... ...I am 
truly... glad."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You? Happy? —You've gotten quite good 
at flattery.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It's the truth. With this—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I can directly... rewrite... your... 
fanaticism...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Only then—will my mission be fulfilled. 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will accomplish it. —Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Very well, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Use your running to completely overwrite 
the stage for my comeback!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you think you can, that is. Right 
now... I am "strong."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Bring it on.
